title: Top 10 Dictation Tools June 2026
summary: Compare built-in dictation, VoiceOS, Wispr Flow, Superwhisper, Aqua Voice, Willow, and Typeless by workflow, offline needs, and privacy.
body_markdown:
## When a dedicated dictation app is worth trying


Dedicated tools become interesting when you spend time fixing the same errors or changing the same formatting. A personal dictionary helps with recurring terms; a correction or replacement feature handles repeated output patterns; an application-specific mode can make one workflow less fiddly. These are useful differences even when two apps use related speech models.


Superwhisper exposes a choice of speech models and optional language-model processing per mode. That makes it a candidate for users who want to configure the pipeline. Wispr Flow emphasizes polished dictation and has desktop and mobile availability. Aqua Voice provides dictation in text boxes; Willow documents a Mac and Windows setup; Typeless advertises several desktop and mobile platforms. These are feature and availability observations, not a measured speed order.\[12\]\[4\]\[5\]\[6\]\[7\]


For a short evaluation, choose two apps with materially different strengths. Comparing seven similar free trials at once makes it easy to lose track of which settings produced which result. Save the raw result and the corrected draft for each. Keep microphone placement, the application, and your sample text consistent, and write down any automatic rewriting you enabled.
